method: Offline calibrated global bind-space delta: inverse(targetAnimatedParentWorld) * sourceAnimatedWorld * inverse(sourceBindWorld) * shortestArc(targetPrimaryDirection,sourcePrimaryDirection) * targetBindWorld
calibrationReason: Visual failure of v1: A-pose target plus T-pose source delta placed hands through torso. Geometric swing calibration aligns anatomical primary directions; shortest arc preserves roll, uses positive-determinant rotations only. Terminal bones use preceding anatomical segment proxy.
sourceRest: Recovered from footballer.glb inverseBindMatrices and mesh world transforms
rootMotion: XZ fixed at target bind; Y source offset from IBM bind scaled by hips height ratio; no arbitrary floor offset
